node.name: PLATFORM_STAGGER_MS
node.docstring:
Stagger requests slightly so 3 concurrent calls don't all hit Gemini in the same tick
(the most common cause of one-platform-succeeds, others-get-429).

node.name: REDIS_TIMEOUT_MS
node.docstring:
Fail-open budget: if Redis doesn't answer within this, Upstash resolves the
check as allowed. A rate-limiter outage must never take down uploads.
CLAUDE.md #1.
